warnings: op1 direct read (house 08). This sheet's B2/B3/B4/B5/B3X/B5X pattern matches spec §7's documented real-case precedent almost verbatim (curtailed-bar-merges-into-bottom for B2/B4/B5/B3, lap-splice-bar-merges-into-top for the 'X' marks) — applied that precedent directly for B2/B3/B4/B3X/B5X. B5 itself deviates from the simple 2+1=3 pattern (its own bottom line already prints the full '3', with a separate '2-ø16หยุดL/8' additional line) and was flagged rather than force-merged into an assumed total.
C1's two rebar tiers (0.15x0.15 above ring-beam level vs. 0.20x0.20 from floor down to footing) read from the ตารางเสา (column table) at bottom-left of this sheet.

CN/CX rise-range notes cross-check cleanly against the ridge/roof-frame notes already recorded in หน้า00_gridline.json's non_grid_dimensions entry — independent confirmation, master file not edited by this read.
